message_text: Your chatbot gave me wrong information last week and I missed a deadline because of it
I'm very sorry to hear that. Could you share what information was provided and which deadline was affected?
It told me the add/drop deadline was February 7th but it was actually January 31st. I missed dropping a class and now I'm stuck with it.

I sincerely apologize for that error. Please contact the Registrar's office and explain the situation. They may be able to process a late drop with documentation of the incorrect information you received.
I'll try but I doubt they'll care. This AI should not be giving out wrong dates.
You're absolutely right, and I'm very sorry. I recommend requesting a meeting with the Registrar's office directly. Reference ticket #INC-2947 for this conversation.
